annotation.authors_or_issuer: Morone, G.; Pirrera, A.; Meli, P.; Giansanti, D.
key_provisions_or_claims: Survey of 155 health professionals on ethics in rehabilitation and assistance robotics
Respondents saw regulation issues as the area most needing training (mean 5.50/6)
Ethics training is needed at university and in the workplace
Ethical concerns include replacement of humans, responsibility, trust, privacy and deception
Authors plan to extend the survey to a wider professional audience
annotation.summary_en: Journal article reporting an electronic survey of 155 Italian health professionals on ethics in rehabilitation and assistance robotics. It covers ethics training, organisational aspects and ethical concerns. Respondents most wanted more training on regulation issues. The authors recommend continuing and widening the study.
annotation.title_clean: Ethics and Automated Systems in the Health Domain: Design and Submission of a Survey on Rehabilitation and Assistance Robotics to Collect Insiders' Opinions and Perception
annotation.title_en: Ethics and Automated Systems in the Health Domain: Design and Submission of a Survey on Rehabilitation and Assistance Robotics to Collect Insiders' Opinions and Perception
